data_notes.craft_counts: Planner estimates based on a community skill-up model. Follow actual skill until the target is reached.
data_notes.shopping: Route quantities sum materials_per_craft multiplied by each step's safe count, before inventory, disenchanting yields or other acquired materials. Reusable tools are separate.
data_notes.cost_raw: Numeric values copied from source. Currency denominations were not specified.
data_notes.rank_steps: Train once the prerequisites are met and before the skill cap, including during a craft step that crosses the cap.

source_estimate.source: Wowhead: Tried & Tested in Forever, version 2

steps.instructions: Unconfirmed until checked on a live realm: how a new enchanter gets the first rod. Keep the Runed Copper Rod: every enchant up to 155 needs it. Mote of Magic is sold by enchanting supply vendors.
Disenchant Uncommon (green) or better items to 20: each one is a skill point. Keep the dust and essences for the next steps. Past 20 the chance drops, and it stops at 60.
Keep the Runed Silver Rod: the enchants from here to 155 need it.
Keep the Runed Golden Rod: the enchants from here to 200 need it.
Keep the Runed Truesilver Rod: the enchants from here to 290 need it.
Keep the Runed Arcanite Rod: the last enchants need it.

steps.instructions: Craft 60 and Save
Buy a Blacksmith Hammer and keep it in your bags (a better one, such as Mithril Blacksmith Hammer, Twilight Forgehammer, Arcanite Blacksmith Hammer, works too).
Craft 30 and Save
Keep the Arclight Spanner: most later recipes need it as a tool.
Keep the Gyromatic Micro-Adjustor: goggles and scopes need it as a tool.
